select bc1.coupon_name, ccr.card_number, ccr.card_id, if(isnull(bc.sold_date) , null, bp.name) as buyer, bp1.name as activator, max(ccr.current_amount) as beginDeduction, sum(case when ccr.occur_type = 2 then ccr.occur_amount else 0 end) as thisDeduction, sum(case when ccr.occur_type = 3 then ccr.occur_amount else 0 end) as thisDeductionRefund, min(ccr.current_amount) as endDeduction from coupon_change_record ccr inner join base_card bc on bc.card_id = ccr.card_id inner join base_coupon bc1 on bc1.coupon_id = ccr.coupon_id left join base_patient bp on bp.patient_id = bc.sold_target left join base_patient bp1 on bp1.patient_id = bc.patient_id
`ccr`.`coupon_id` in
#{item}
and (ccr.occur_date >= #{query.startDate} and ccr.occur_date < DATE_ADD(#{query.endDate} ,INTERVAL '1' DAY))
and (`bp`.`name` like concat('%', #{query.patientKeyword}, '%') or `bp`.`mobile` like concat('%', #{query.patientKeyword}, '%') or `bp`.`pinyin_name` like concat('%', #{query.patientKeyword}, '%')) and (`bp1`.`name` like concat('%', #{query.patientKeyword}, '%') or `bp1`.`mobile` like concat('%', #{query.patientKeyword}, '%') or `bp1`.`pinyin_name` like concat('%', #{query.patientKeyword}, '%'))
group by ccr.card_id,ccr.patient_id

select cci.coupon_name as couponName, c.card_number as cardNumber, c.sale_channel_name as saleChannel, dip.package_unit_price as saleAmount, cb.item_id as itemName, cb.item_type, count(*) as quantity, bp.name as patientName, b.bill_num, date_format(cb.use_date, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as `billDate`, cb.org_id as orgName, be.employee_name as executorName from base_benefit cb inner join base_card c on cb.card_id = c.card_id inner join base_coupon cci on c.coupon_id = cci.coupon_id left join deduction_item dip on dip.item_id = cb.item_id and dip.coupon_id = cb.coupon_id and dip.type = cb.item_type left join base_coupon_order_virtual cov on c.card_id = cov.card_id left join base_coupon_bill b on cov.order_id = b.order_id left join base_patient bp on bp.patient_id = cb.patient_id left join base_employee be on be.user_id = cb.operate_user_id where cb.coupon_type = 5
and (cb.use_date >= #{query.startDate} and cb.use_date < DATE_ADD(#{query.endDate} ,INTERVAL '1' DAY))
and `c`.`sale_channel_id` in
#{item}
and `cci`.`product_type_id` in
#{item}
and `cci`.`coupon_name` like concat('%', #{query.couponName}, '%')
and `c`.`card_number` like concat('%', #{query.cardNumber}, '%')
and (`bp`.`name` like concat('%', #{query.patientKeyword}, '%') or `bp`.`mobile` like concat('%', #{query.patientKeyword}, '%') or `bp`.`pinyin_name` like concat('%', #{query.patientKeyword}, '%'))
and `cb`.`org_id` in
#{item}
and dip.crt_time = (select max(crt_time) from deduction_item where coupon_id = cci.coupon_id and crt_time <= ifnull(c.sold_date, c.active_date)) group by cb.card_id, b.bill_num, cb.item_id
